issues: Warm paper stage with white cards, and the focus card was as bright as its neighbours, so it was unclear which piece of evidence was current
Nothing visually linked the 116px serif words to the strip; the word block aligning to the card centre was invisible
New words faded in whole, so the relay lacked a click; noun and verb shared colour and style, flattening the hierarchy
The frame held only cards and words, with no readable supporting information
changes: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark with gold accents); the forced black/white card alternation reads stronger on the dark stage, with deep two-layer shadows and hairline edges
Depth of field: neighbour cards dim by 0.68·dist, scale to 0.94 and blur up to 3px, so each 18f step pulls new evidence into focus; stepping and fast-phase vertical motion blur are kept

Didot 140px on the right: the noun 'Atlas' stays upright in secondary ink, the verb is white italic; the old verb greys out and rises out of its mask in 8f ease-in, and the new verb rises letter by letter (1.2f stagger, gold period last)

A gold leader runs from the focus card's right edge to the word block's centre line at y=540, retracting on each switch and redrawing once the new evidence lands, making the text-to-image alignment visible
A mono 01/03 index above and a 32px evidence caption below relay with each verb; slow 1→1.02 push; 170→180f
